## Summary

Describe the user or operator outcome.

## Verification

- [ ] Lint
- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Contract tests, when relevant
- [ ] Production build
- [ ] Mobile and desktop smoke check

## Stellar impact

State the network, contract function, authorization change, storage change, and
whether existing deployment evidence remains valid.

## Security

- [ ] No secrets, private keys, or signed reusable envelopes
- [ ] Screenshots and documentation updated when needed
